body:
Scope: independent rereview of the complete revised proposal following the user's explicit expansion to retire explicit-recording-v1 and all named old compact/lifecycle stored formats while retaining rigorloop-records-v2. This is a new direction assessment on changed proposal bytes, not restored applicability of the prior compact-only approval. The earlier permanent compatibility non-goal is expressly superseded; its old approval supplies no authority for this expansion.

Core dimensions: challenge pass (multiple supported runtime formats and engines retain maintenance and protection obligations); goals pass (v2-only destination and preserved v2 safety/evidence integrity); scope pass (exact six-format retirement set across readers, validators, creators, writers and exclusive engines); principle pass (explicit compatibility decision before removal); direction pass (concrete final unsupported-input destination with bounded temporary continuation/recovery); feasibility pass for detailed Design only; impact pass (old-reader/writer compatibility break and stranded-work risk disclosed); downstream authority pass (Record Format, Workflow and CLI own exact compatibility mapping, commands, transitions, diagnostics and Delivery allocation); requested decision pass (broader direction explicitly selected without current retirement, migration or implementation).

Vision alignment: aligned. Durable historical meaning and inspection must remain possible as archival evidence, with neither fabricated origin nor current approval inferred from preservation. Safe operational continuation and interrupted-write recovery require actual dispositions before cutover; archival bytes alone do not provide them. The proposal expressly recognizes these constraints and retains independent review/final Verify, so a smaller runtime surface does not abandon the vision's traceability and resumption goals.

Scope preservation: the user now explicitly selects explicit-recording-v1, compact-current-state-v1, stage-owned-change-local-v1/v2/v3 and legacy-unversioned retirement. All are named, and rigorloop-records-v2 is retained. The scope includes normal and advanced entrypoints, schemas, constructors, projection, activation, shared consumers and exclusive tests. Old-format readers/validators are not accidentally retained forever. Temporary tools have owners and removal conditions; Design may not use them as hidden indefinite compatibility. Separate domain markers Model validation contract: explicit-recording-v1 and targeted-recording-v1 transport are explicitly distinguished from stored-record contracts. Shared v2 safety cannot be removed by matching old-format names.

Specialized scope_budget_context applies: broader work is explicitly split into a coordinated direction and independently reviewable Delivery slices, with Record Format added to the minimum Workflow/CLI package. Automation/calibration and release tooling remain separate owner decisions. Concrete blocking dependencies must be surfaced rather than silently deleted or hidden. The duplicate reconciliation and five-case audit remain bounded preparatory work. The earlier thirteen historical-suite removals remain disclosed protection loss, not retirement evidence; this proposal neither blanket-restores nor further deletes them.

Independent feasibility basis: the unchanged runtime separates recording, compact and lifecycle dispatch, but compact creation consumes active activation and projection depends on eligibility while recovery shares transaction machinery. Newly inspected record-store-format defines V1_FORMAT and uses shared format dispatch; recording command help explicitly supports v1 field differences. Lifecycle constants name all three stage-owned contracts and legacy-unversioned. Current Record Format expressly retains v1 reads/updates and advanced creation, and CLI permits explicit dispatch without conversion. These compatibility clauses genuinely require revision, rather than implementation merely removing unreachable code. V1 lacks v2 retained-origin guarantees; transition cannot fill gaps by pretending historical concerns had fresh origin. Selecting v2 alone does not inherently require a new schema version.

Required Design conditions remain explicit: authoritative existing-work inventory is not established because the independently observed workflow-context query blocks on an invalid historical change; an empty candidate list proves no absence. External callers/support assumptions, archival access, recovery state, temporary tools and exit conditions must be dispositioned before disabling sole continuation paths. Current support persists until an approved transition is adopted. Shared schema/parsing/transaction helpers and rejection/no-fallback/no-write safety require surviving-boundary proof. Existing retirement policy's vocabulary and adoption must be reconciled without a new ledger or invented automatic migration authority.

Evidence limits: the retained compact ten-case pass is unchanged-boundary proof, not full multi-format retirement feasibility validation. The earlier 116-test duplicate proof still applies to its unchanged isolated correction. The unchanged stale M4 source assertion remains a disclosed failure; four other audited candidates passed and all five remain untouched. Neither this rereview nor old green results establish current global readiness, absent consumers, migration success or retirement activation. No repeated suite is necessary merely to assess changed direction prose on unchanged runtime evidence.

No material proposal defect or unresolved necessary direction-level decision emerged. No vision-exception or missing-standing-artifact gate applies. Approve the expanded direction only as sufficient for detailed Design, with its declared compatibility conditions and ownership package. Return at the isolated review boundary; do not start Design, alter engineering/routing, activate retirement or renew unrelated review evidence through this save.
independence_basis: Separate delegated reviewer /root/independent_proposal_review did not author this proposal or preparatory correction. Independently inspected exact subjects, actual existing implementation boundaries and evidence; writes only review judgments, not authoring or routing state.
